answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 28648 Country: India Title: The den mohar was given after 18 years of marriage.during marriage it was 2000,so tell that after 18 years will it be 2000 or change according to time. Question: As salamo alaikum wr wb.The denmohar was given after 18 years of marriage.during marriage it was 2000,so tell that after 18 years will it be 2000 or change according to time. Answer ID: 28648 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 55/41/L=1432) In the question mentioned above, the mahr shall be 2000. It will not undergo any change with the passage of time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
